check: Bedrooms take 60 minutes, the living room 60, and two bathrooms 2 × 120 = 240; house plus outside takes 360 × 3 = 1080 minutes. James and his two siblings divide this among 3 people: 1080 ÷ 3 ÷ 60 = 6 hours each.
